description: Universal AI bridge for Obsidian vaults - connect any MCP-compatible assistant
author: bitbonsai

tool_signatures.name: delete_note
tool_signatures.description: Delete a note from the Obsidian vault (requires confirmation). Supports permanent delete, vault trash, or system trash.

tool_signatures.name: get_frontmatter
tool_signatures.description: Extract frontmatter from a note without reading the content

tool_signatures.name: get_note_outline
tool_signatures.description: Get the heading structure of a note without reading its full content. Returns headings with level, text, and line number. Use this first to navigate large notes efficiently, then call read_note_lines to read only the section you need.

tool_signatures.name: get_notes_info
tool_signatures.description: Get metadata for notes without reading full content

tool_signatures.name: get_vault_stats
tool_signatures.description: Get vault statistics including total notes, folders, size, and recently modified files. Useful for understanding vault scope before batch operations.

tool_signatures.name: list_all_tags
tool_signatures.description: List all tags across the vault with occurrence counts. Returns both frontmatter tags and inline #hashtags, deduplicated and sorted by frequency. Useful for discovering existing tags before creating or organizing notes.

tool_signatures.name: list_directory
tool_signatures.description: List files and directories in the vault (includes non-note filenames, while read/write tools remain note-only)

tool_signatures.name: manage_tags
tool_signatures.description: Add, remove, or list tags in a note

tool_signatures.name: move_file
tool_signatures.description: Move or rename any file in the vault (binary-safe, file-only, requires confirmation)

tool_signatures.name: move_note
tool_signatures.description: Move or rename a note in the vault

tool_signatures.name: patch_note
tool_signatures.description: Efficiently update part of a note by replacing a specific string. This is more efficient than rewriting the entire note for small changes.

tool_signatures.name: read_multiple_notes
tool_signatures.description: Read multiple notes in a batch (max 10 files)

tool_signatures.name: read_note
tool_signatures.description: Read a note from the Obsidian vault

tool_signatures.name: read_note_lines
tool_signatures.description: Read a specific line range from a note. Use after get_note_outline to read only the section you need instead of the full file.

tool_signatures.name: search_notes
tool_signatures.description: Search for notes in the vault by content or frontmatter

tool_signatures.name: update_frontmatter
tool_signatures.description: Update frontmatter of a note without changing content

tool_signatures.name: wiki_link
tool_signatures.description: Read an Obsidian wiki link. Accepts the same syntax as Obsidian: [[Document Name]] or [[Document Name|Display Text]], including table-authored escapes like [[Document Name\\|Display]] and path-qualified links like [[folder/Document Name]]. A #fragment suffix in the input is ignored. Searches the vault for an exact basename match (or exact vault-relative path match when the name contains
